description: This file defines the ShareRepository class for managing sharing functionalities in the Nextcloud Notes Android client. It includes methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting shares, as well as handling share-related data and API interactions.

classes.name: ShareRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing share operations such as creating, updating, retrieving, and deleting shares within the Nextcloud Notes Android client.

methods.name: getNotesPathResponseResult
methods.description: Retrieves the server settings related to notes, including path and suffix.

methods.name: getNotePath
methods.description: Constructs the file path for a given note based on server settings.

methods.name: getShareEntitiesForSpecificNote
methods.description: Fetches share entities associated with a specific note.

methods.name: getExpirationDate
methods.description: Converts a timestamp in milliseconds to an expiration date string or null if not set.

methods.name: getCapabilities
methods.description: Returns the capabilities of the notes repository.

methods.name: getSharesForNotesAndSaveShareEntities
methods.description: Fetches shares for notes and saves the share entities locally.

methods.name: getSharees
methods.description: Retrieves a list of sharee users, groups, remotes, emails, circles, and rooms based on search criteria.

methods.name: getUpdateShareRequest
methods.description: Constructs an update request for a share, including permissions, expiration, and other attributes.

methods.name: getShares
methods.description: Retrieves shares associated with a remote ID.

methods.name: sendEmail
methods.description: Sends an email related to a share, such as sharing links or notifications.

methods.name: getShareFromNote
methods.description: Retrieves share details associated with a specific note.

methods.name: removeShare
methods.description: Removes a share and updates the note sharing status if necessary.

methods.name: updateShare
methods.description: Updates an existing share with new parameters.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates a note in the repository.

methods.name: addShare
methods.description: Creates a new share for a note with specified parameters.

methods.name: updateSharePermission
methods.description: Updates the permissions of an existing share.
